items.title: 鴻海攜手輝達推進機器人組裝技術導入GB300生產 Busbar組裝成功率超過95%
items.title_en: Foxconn Teams with NVIDIA to Advance Robot Assembly Technology, GB300 Busbar Assembly Success Rate Exceeds 95%
paras: 輝達(NVIDIA)(NVDA-US)技術部最新文章指出，技術團隊攜手鴻海(2317-TW)將最新機器人自動化技術導入GB300組裝製程，目前Busbar(匯流排)組裝成功率已超過95%，多連接器插接成功率約90%至95%，並持續朝製造端要求的99.5%成功率邁進。
此次合作由輝達西雅圖機器人實驗室(Seattle Robotics Lab, SRL)與Isaac工程團隊共同推進，並與輝達營運團隊及代工夥伴鴻海合作，針對GB300測試托盤(tester trays)組裝中的Busbar組裝及多連接器插接兩項任務進行機器人訓練與測試。輝達指出，這兩項任務也是由營運團隊與鴻海共同建議鎖定的關鍵應用。
技術團隊指出，由於GB300測試托盤的零件擺放、幾何形狀及纜線狀態存在不確定性，無法完全依賴傳統固定式自動化，因此採取傳統機器人感知、規劃與控制技術，搭配機器人學習等方法，依不同任務尋找適合的解決方案，並以實際製造需求作為成功率與作業時間的評估標準。
其中，Busbar組裝涉及將長且沉重的Busbar插入托盤、鎖固16顆螺絲，以及相關治具與夾具的安裝、拆卸，目前成功率已超過95%。不過，受到螺絲需逐一鎖固影響，目前整體作業時間約160秒，團隊表示，後續將持續優化，朝縮短至124秒內的目標邁進。
多連接器插接則涉及2個大型及2個小型電氣連接器，機器人需提起帶有可變形纜線的連接器，再精準插入間隙極小的對應插座，目前成功率約90%至95%，4組連接器的作業時間目標控制在72秒內，整體作業週期時間(cycle time)則以不超過熟練人工2倍時間為目標。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) technical department’s latest article notes that its team, together with Foxconn (2317-TW), has introduced the newest robotic automation technology into the GB300 assembly process, achieving a busbar assembly success rate of over 95% and a multi‑connector insertion success rate of roughly 90%‑95%, while continuing to push toward the manufacturing‑side target of 99.5% success.

The collaboration is driven by NVIDIA’s Seattle Robotics Lab (SRL) and the Isaac engineering team, working alongside NVIDIA’s operations group and contract‑manufacturing partner Foxconn. They are training and testing robots on two tasks in the GB300 tester‑tray assembly – busbar installation and multi‑connector insertion – which the operations team and Foxconn identified as key applications.

The technical team explains that because the placement, geometry, and cable condition of GB300 tester‑tray components are uncertain, traditional fixed‑line automation cannot be relied upon. Instead, they employ conventional robot perception, planning and control techniques combined with robot learning methods, selecting solutions tailored to each task and using actual manufacturing requirements as the benchmark for success rates and cycle times.

Busbar assembly involves inserting a long, heavy busbar into the tray, securing it with 16 screws, and installing or removing related fixtures and clamps. The current success rate has surpassed 95%. However, because each screw must be tightened individually, the overall operation takes about 160 seconds; the team aims to further optimize the process to bring the time down to under 124 seconds.

Multi‑connector insertion deals with two large and two small electrical connectors. The robot must lift a connector with a deformable cable and precisely insert it into a very tight socket. Success is currently around 90%‑95%, with a target of completing the four‑connector operation within 72 seconds, and the overall cycle time is aimed to be no more than twice that of a skilled human operator.

items.title: 貝森特出面打強心劑！美債殖利率飆升「反映全球趨勢」、AI泡沫「不用太擔心」
items.title_en: Bessent Steps In as a Booster! U.S. Treasury Yields Surge “Reflecting Global Trends”, AI Bubble “Not Too Worrisome”
paras: 美國公債殖利率近期持續攀升，10年期公債殖利率一度升至2002年以來最高水準，引發市場對通膨壓力、高利率及美國財政狀況的憂慮。不過，美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）認為，近期美債殖利率走高與全球市場趨勢一致，並非美國獨有的資金流出現象，市場無須過度恐慌。
根據《彭博》報導，貝森特接受《Axios》專訪時表示，目前並未看到投資人拋售美國公債、轉而買進德國或日本公債的情況。
他認為，如果看到某種美國獨有的異常升幅，才是需要感到擔憂的狀況。
不過，貝森特也坦言，自己無法控制債券市場，但能做的是讓市場參與者放慢腳步、審慎思考。
近期美債市場已歷經數月賣壓，儘管週五（2日）美國就業數據疲軟，稍微緩解市場壓力，10年期公債殖利率本週仍一度攀升至2002年以來最高水準。
伊朗戰爭持續延燒，推升能源價格，加上美國財政體質疑慮，以及人工智慧（AI）產業大舉投入資本支出，共同推高市場借貸成本。
美國柴油價格創下歷史新高，房貸利率也已遠高於7%，進一步加重民眾生活成本壓力。
生活成本已成為美國選民關注的核心議題，也讓美國總統川普及共和黨面臨更大政治壓力。隨著11月期中選舉逼近，共和黨在國會選舉中失利的風險升高，民主黨可能因此取得國會參眾兩院控制權。
面對經濟疑慮，貝森特則強調，伊朗戰爭帶來的連鎖衝擊，掩蓋了美國經濟原本的韌性。他指出，美國消費支出依然強勁，薪資中位數增幅也與整體通膨率大致一致。
除了美債市場，貝森特也談及美國對阿根廷的金融援助，並對未來再次採取類似行動抱持開放態度。
川普政府去年透過買進阿根廷披索，並向阿根廷總統米雷伊（Javier Milei）政府提供200億美元貨幣互換額度，協助阿根廷穩定匯率，避免經濟危機全面爆發。
貝森特表示，阿根廷局勢穩定為拉丁美洲帶來重大轉變，讓美國與拉美國家之間的結盟關係出現世代性的變化，甚至可能是歷史上首次有如此多拉美國家與美國站在同一陣線。
他也明確表示，未來若有需要，美國可以再次採取類似措施。
此外，美國也曾協助日本支撐日元匯率，兩國更自1998年以來首度聯手進場買進日元。
針對市場對AI投資熱潮可能形成泡沫的擔憂，貝森特則不認同過度悲觀的看法。
他指出，微軟(MSFT-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下Google及Meta(META-US) 等科技巨頭持續投入大量資本，同時也為Anthropic與OpenAI等AI企業帶來可觀營收成長。
至於能源價格與通膨壓力，他預期，隨著這場已持續進入第八個月的伊朗戰爭逐步落幕，全球石油供應將更加充裕，能源衝擊也會隨之消退。
貝森特表示，美國終將走出伊朗戰爭帶來的衝擊。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields have been climbing sharply, with the 10‑year yield briefly reaching its highest level since 2002, sparking market concerns about inflation pressure, high rates and the U.S. fiscal situation. However, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the recent rise in U.S. bond yields aligns with global market trends and is not a uniquely American capital outflow, so markets need not panic.
According to Bloomberg, Bessent told Axios in an interview that he does not see investors dumping U.S. Treasuries in favor of German or Japanese bonds.
He adds that only if there were an abnormal rise unique to the United States would there be cause for concern.
Bessent also admits he cannot control the bond market, but he can encourage participants to slow down and think more carefully.

The U.S. bond market has endured months of selling pressure; although weak U.S. jobs data on Friday (the 2nd) eased some pressure, the 10‑year yield still climbed to its highest level since 2002 this week.
The ongoing Iran war is pushing up energy prices, and together with concerns about U.S. fiscal health and massive AI‑related capital spending, it is lifting borrowing costs across the market.
U.S. diesel prices have hit historic highs and mortgage rates are now well above 7%, further squeezing household living costs.

Rising living‑cost concerns have become a core issue for American voters, putting President Trump and the Republican Party under greater political pressure. With the November mid‑term elections approaching, the GOP faces a higher risk of losing congressional seats, which could give Democrats control of both chambers.

Addressing economic worries, Bessent stresses that the chain reaction from the Iran war is masking the underlying resilience of the U.S. economy. He notes that consumer spending remains strong and median wage growth is roughly in line with overall inflation.
Beyond the bond market, Bessent also discussed U.S. financial assistance to Argentina and expressed openness to similar actions in the future.

Last year the Trump administration bought Argentine pesos and provided President Javier Milei’s government with a $20 billion currency‑swap line to help stabilize the peso and avert a full‑blown economic crisis.

Bessent said that a stable Argentina represents a major shift for Latin America, creating a generational change in the alliance between the United States and the region and possibly the first time so many Latin American countries have stood on the same side as the U.S.
He made it clear that the United States could take comparable measures again if needed.
The United States has also helped Japan support the yen, and the two countries jointly bought yen for the first time since 1998.
Regarding worries that the AI investment boom could become a bubble, Bessent rejects an overly pessimistic view.

He points out that tech giants such as Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet’s Google (GOOGL‑US) and Meta (META‑US) continue to pour massive capital into AI, while companies like Anthropic and OpenAI are seeing substantial revenue growth.
On energy prices and inflation pressure, he expects that as the Iran war, now in its eighth month, winds down, global oil supply will become more abundant and the energy shock will recede.
Bessent says the United States will eventually emerge from the impacts of the Iran war.
This article is not available for partner re‑publication.

items.title: 胡塞武裝襲擊沙烏地阿美煉油廠！沙國籌備大規模反攻、能源危機升溫
items.title_en: Houthi Forces Attack Saudi Aramco Refinery! Saudi Arabia Prepares Massive Counteroffensive, Energy Crisis Intensifies
paras: 葉門胡塞武裝與沙烏地阿拉伯之間的軍事衝突持續升級。胡塞武裝聲稱，已於當地時間週六（3日）晚間動用彈道飛彈及無人機，攻擊位於沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德的沙烏地阿美（Saudi Aramco）設施，並宣稱成功命中目標、引發火災。與此同時，沙烏地阿拉伯正籌備大規模軍事行動，計畫奪回胡塞武裝控制的沿海戰略據點，進一步加劇中東能源供應與航運安全風險。
根據陸媒《央視新聞》報導，胡塞武裝表示，此次攻擊是為了報復沙烏地阿拉伯對葉門首都沙那及其他地區發動空襲。胡塞武裝聲稱，行動已達成預定目標，並對目標造成破壞。
沙烏地阿拉伯方面尚未對襲擊事件發表正式聲明。社群平台X流傳的未經證實畫面顯示，利雅德一處阿美煉油設施多處冒出濃煙。
土耳其媒體《Türkiye Today》引述美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）火災資訊資源管理系統（FIRMS）的衛星監測資料指出，煉油廠周邊出現高強度熱輻射訊號。
利雅德煉油廠是沙烏地阿拉伯重要的煉油資產之一，日處理能力約13萬桶。
胡塞武裝另指控，沙烏地阿拉伯在過去24小時內對葉門發動60次空襲及飛彈攻擊，自9月3日局勢升級以來，累計攻擊次數已達1,410次。
胡塞武裝揚言，將持續採取「以封鎖對封鎖、以升級對升級」的策略，直到沙烏地阿拉伯停止攻擊，並解除對胡塞武裝控制區港口及機場的限制。

沙烏地阿拉伯籌備大規模反攻　美國暫不直接介入

在胡塞武裝發動攻擊之際，沙烏地阿拉伯也正準備展開大規模軍事反攻。
美國新聞網站《Axios》引述兩名美國官員報導指出，沙烏地阿拉伯已籌備數周，並於數日前獲得高層批准，計畫在未來幾天內對胡塞武裝發動大規模軍事行動。
這項行動將由葉門政府地面部隊主導，沙烏地阿拉伯空軍提供支援，主要目標是打擊胡塞武裝在沿海地區的戰略據點，削弱其對曼德海峽周邊地區的控制能力。
據美國官員透露，沙烏地阿拉伯國防部長哈立德・本・薩勒曼王子（Khalid bin Salman）上周四已致電美國國防部長赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth），通報軍事行動計畫，並再次要求美國對胡塞武裝目標發動空襲。
不過，美國官員表示，美方目前不會採取直接軍事行動，意味沙烏地阿拉伯此次反攻暫時不會獲得美軍直接空襲支援。
胡塞武裝近期持續加大對葉門政府軍的攻勢，並宣布對支持葉門政府的沙烏地阿拉伯實施海上禁運。
根據《央視》報導，胡塞武裝已攻占葉門港口城市穆哈及丕林島等戰略據點。葉門政府9月11日表示，胡塞武裝已控制全國西部海岸，並將攻勢推進至南部拉赫季省。

伊朗45天期限屆滿　中東衝突升級風險升高

除了沙烏地阿拉伯與胡塞武裝的衝突，美國與伊朗之間的緊張關係也為區域局勢增添變數。
此前，芝加哥大學政治學者Robert Pape曾警告，10月1日可能成為這波衝突進入新階段的關鍵時間點。
Pape指出，伊朗最高國家安全委員會於8月16日作出決定，若美國未能在45天內解除對伊朗港口的海上封鎖，德黑蘭將保留對美軍發動新一輪攻擊的選項。
他表示，這項期限如今已經屆滿。
另一方面，美國總統川普上周接受《時代》雜誌專訪時重申，如果美伊雙方無法在美國期中選舉前達成可接受的協議，他可能在選舉後加大對伊朗的軍事打擊力度。
胡塞武裝攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯能源設施、沙烏地阿拉伯籌備大規模反攻，以及美伊談判僵局與伊朗設定的期限相互交織，使中東局勢面臨更多不確定性，區域能源供應與國際航運安全也成為市場關注焦點。
paras_en: The military conflict between Yemen's Houthi forces and Saudi Arabia continues to escalate. The Houthis claim they launched ballistic missiles and drones on Saturday night (the 3rd local time), targeting Saudi Aramco facilities in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and say they hit the target and caused a fire. At the same time, Saudi Arabia is preparing a large‑scale military operation to retake coastal strategic positions held by the Houthis, further heightening Middle‑East energy supply and shipping security risks.

According to Chinese state media CCTV News, the Houthis said the attack was retaliation for Saudi airstrikes on Yemen’s capital Sana’a and other areas. The Houthis claim the operation achieved its intended objectives and inflicted damage on the target.

Saudi officials have not yet issued an official statement on the attack. Unverified footage circulating on the social platform X shows thick smoke billowing from an Aramco refinery facility in Riyadh.
Turkish outlet Türkiye Today cited NASA’s FIRMS satellite fire‑monitoring data, which showed high‑intensity thermal radiation signals around the refinery.
The Riyadh refinery is one of Saudi Arabia’s key refining assets, with a daily processing capacity of about 130,000 barrels.

The Houthis also allege that Saudi Arabia carried out 60 airstrikes and missile attacks on Yemen in the past 24 hours, and that since the escalation on September 3 the total number of attacks has reached 1,410.

The Houthis warned they will continue a “blockade for blockade, escalation for escalation” strategy until Saudi Arabia stops its attacks and lifts restrictions on ports and airports in Houthi‑controlled areas.
Saudi Arabia is preparing a massive counteroffensive while the Houthis launch their attack.

Axios quoted two U.S. officials saying Saudi Arabia has been planning for weeks and received high‑level approval a few days ago, intending to launch a large‑scale military operation against the Houthis in the coming days.
The operation will be led by Yemeni government ground forces with Saudi air support, targeting Houthi strategic footholds along the coast to weaken their control around the Bab al‑Mandeb Strait.

U.S. officials disclosed that Saudi Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman called U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth last Thursday to brief him on the plan and again asked the United States to strike Houthi targets.
However, U.S. officials said Washington will not take direct military action, meaning the Saudi counteroffensive will not receive direct U.S. air‑strike support at this time.
The Houthis have recently intensified attacks on Yemen’s government forces and announced a maritime blockade against Saudi Arabia for supporting the Yemeni government.

CCTV reported that the Houthis have seized strategic points such as the Yemeni port city of Mocha and Perim Island. Yemen’s government said on September 11 that the Houthis now control the entire western coast and are pushing the offensive into the southern Lahij governorate.
Iran’s 45‑day deadline has expired, raising the risk of an expanded Middle‑East conflict.
Previously, University of Chicago political scientist Robert Pape warned that October 1 could be a pivotal date for a new phase of the conflict.

Pape noted that Iran’s Supreme National Security Council decided on August 16 that if the United States does not lift the maritime blockade on Iranian ports within 45 days, Tehran will retain the option to launch a new round of attacks against U.S. forces.
He said that deadline has now passed.

Meanwhile, former U.S. President Donald Trump told TIME magazine last week that if the U.S. and Iran cannot reach an acceptable deal before the U.S. mid‑term elections, he may increase military pressure on Iran after the election.

The intertwining of Houthi attacks on Saudi energy facilities, Saudi preparations for a large‑scale counteroffensive, and the stalemate in U.S.–Iran talks with Iran’s deadline creates greater uncertainty in the Middle East, putting regional energy supply and international shipping safety at the forefront of market concerns.

items.title: 蘋果證實iPhone 18 Pro Max爆斷訊問題！受影響用戶須更換手機
items.title_en: Apple Confirms iPhone 18 Pro Max Connectivity Issue; Affected Users Must Replace Device
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 證實，「少數」使用美國電信商AT&T(T-US) 網路的iPhone 18 Pro Max出現行動網路連線問題，導致裝置無法使用電信服務，甚至無法撥打電話。
根據《9to5Mac》報導，蘋果已推出軟體更新及電信業者設定更新，以防止問題影響更多用戶。不過，蘋果表示，已經失去行動網路服務的裝置必須更換硬體才能恢復正常使用。
蘋果向科技媒體《9to5Mac》表示，公司已確認少數使用AT&T網路的iPhone 18 Pro Max受到影響，可能出現裝置失去行動網路服務、無法撥打電話等情況。
為防止更多用戶遇到相同問題，蘋果已於本週稍早推出iOS 27.0.1，並呼籲所有iPhone 18 Pro Max用戶立即更新。此外，蘋果也將於當天發布電信業者設定更新，兩項更新將共同降低問題發生的風險。
這項電信業者設定更新將在未來14天內自動下載至iPhone 18 Pro Max。用戶若希望立即安裝，也可以自行前往「設定」，依序點選「一般」及「關於本機」，手動更新。
不過，蘋果強調，這些更新僅能預防問題再次發生，無法修復已經失去行動網路服務的裝置。
蘋果表示，已經發生斷訊的iPhone 18 Pro Max用戶需要更換新手機。這些用戶應聯繫蘋果支援或AT&T，或前往Apple Store及AT&T門市尋求協助。
根據《9to5Mac》稍早報導，受影響的iPhone 18 Pro Max無法連接AT&T網路，因此無法使用通話、簡訊及行動數據服務，手機狀態列則會顯示「SOS」，代表裝置無法正常連接電信網路。
不過，這項問題並未影響所有使用AT&T網路的iPhone 18 Pro Max用戶。
值得注意的是，美國市場販售的iPhone 18 Pro Max搭載高通(QCOM-US) 數據機晶片，而採用蘋果自研C2數據機晶片的iPhone 18 Pro則未受到這次AT&T連線問題影響。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) has confirmed that a "small number" of iPhone 18 Pro Max units using AT&T (T-US) network in the United States are experiencing mobile network connectivity problems, preventing the devices from using cellular services and even making calls.

According to a report by 9to5Mac, Apple has released a software update and a carrier settings update to prevent the issue from affecting more users. However, Apple says devices that have already lost mobile network service must have their hardware replaced to function normally again.
Apple told tech outlet 9to5Mac that the company has identified a small subset of iPhone 18 Pro Max units on AT&T’s network that may lose mobile service and be unable to place calls.

To stop more users from encountering the same problem, Apple rolled out iOS 27.0.1 earlier this week and urged all iPhone 18 Pro Max owners to update immediately. Apple will also release a carrier settings update the same day, with both updates working together to lower the risk of recurrence.

The carrier settings update will automatically download to iPhone 18 Pro Max devices within the next 14 days. Users who want to install it right away can go to Settings → General → About and trigger a manual update.
Apple emphasizes that these updates can only prevent the issue from happening again; they cannot fix devices that have already lost mobile network service.

Apple states that iPhone 18 Pro Max users who have already experienced a loss of service need to replace their phones. Those users should contact Apple Support or AT&T, or visit an Apple Store or AT&T retail location for assistance.

Earlier reporting by 9to5Mac noted that affected iPhone 18 Pro Max units cannot connect to AT&T’s network, rendering calls, texts and mobile data unusable, and the status bar shows "SOS," indicating the device cannot connect to a cellular network properly.
However, the problem does not affect all iPhone 18 Pro Max users on AT&T’s network.

It is worth noting that iPhone 18 Pro Max models sold in the U.S. are equipped with Qualcomm (QCOM-US) modem chips, while the iPhone 18 Pro, which uses Apple’s in‑house C2 modem, is not impacted by this AT&T connectivity issue.

items.title: 美股震盪美債走高免驚！野村提解方：靠「成長+基建+債券」3箭齊發
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Waver, Treasury Yields Rise—No Panic! Nomura Suggests a “Growth + Infrastructure + Bonds” Triple‑Arrow Strategy
paras: 全球金融市場近期波動升溫，美股高檔震盪盤整，加上美債殖利率走高，使高估值科技資產面臨重新定價壓力。面對市場不確定性，野村投信表示，AI引領全球投資的長期趨勢並未改變，但當資金與漲幅高度集中於少數大型科技股時，投資組合更需要尋找多元報酬來源。建議投資人升級資產配置，將投資版圖向外延伸至AI不可或缺的電力、電網與能源基礎建設，並善用高殖利率環境下的債券收益機會，透過「成長＋基建＋債券」三箭齊發，打造攻守兼備的全天候投資策略。
野村投信指出，AI投資機會絕非僅局限於晶片與伺服器等傳統科技產業。隨著全球資料中心（Data Center）建置爆發，AI運算需求呈指數級成長，背後龐大的電力供應、輸配電系統及電網升級需求，正形成一條深具潛力的長期成長鏈。換言之，基礎建設已不再只是傳統概念中的防禦型配置，而是AI產業鏈向外延伸的重要直接受惠者。
同時，歐美地區電氣化進程與能源轉型加速推進，加上液化天然氣（LNG）需求暢旺，亦為基礎建設注入多元長期驅動力。相較過去市場僅將基建視為防守型資產，如今的基礎建設產業已逐漸轉型，轉化為兼具穩定現金流與結構性成長動能的新定位。
在債券配置方面，野村投信分析，當前債券市場的吸引力不僅來自未來利率政策的轉折期待，更在於整體殖利率已處於歷史相對高檔，使債券資產本身即具備優異的收益條件。在操作策略上，投資人不必單押利率走向，而應從存續期間管理、信用品質掌控及收益來源擴充三大面向著手，例如增持5至10年期債券、以成熟國家優質企業投資等級債為核心，並適度搭配次順位金融債，藉此在掌握高殖利率機會的同時，有效提升整體資產配置的穩定度。
展望後市，野村投信強調，市場震盪並不代表必須退場，關鍵在於降低投資組合的集中度風險。AI仍是中長期的核心投資主軸，隨著AI發展進一步帶動電力與能源設施的大量需求，投資機會已順利從科技硬體延伸至基礎建設。投資人在續抱AI成長趨勢之餘，若能靈活搭配受惠AI用電需求的基建資產與具收益吸引力的債券，透過跨產業、跨資產的多元布局，就能在市場波動中建構兼具成長、收益與穩定度的全天候資產組合。

paras_en: Global financial markets have been volatile lately, with U.S. equities stuck in a high‑level range and Treasury yields climbing, putting pressure on over‑valued tech assets to be re‑priced. Facing uncertainty, Nomura Asset Management says AI remains the long‑term investment trend, but when capital and gains are heavily concentrated in a few mega‑cap tech stocks, portfolios need diversified sources of return. It recommends investors upgrade their asset allocation by extending exposure to the power, grid and energy infrastructure that AI cannot do without, and by taking advantage of bond yields in the current high‑yield environment, employing a “Growth + Infrastructure + Bonds” three‑arrow approach for an all‑weather, offensive‑defensive strategy.

Nomura notes that AI investment opportunities are not limited to traditional tech sectors like chips and servers. As data‑center construction booms worldwide, AI computing demand is growing exponentially, driving massive needs for electricity supply, transmission and distribution systems, and grid upgrades—forming a long‑term growth chain with great potential. In other words, infrastructure is no longer just a defensive play; it is a direct beneficiary of the AI value chain’s outward expansion.

At the same time, the electrification and energy‑transition push in Europe and the U.S., together with strong LNG demand, injects diverse long‑term drivers into infrastructure. Whereas the market once viewed infrastructure solely as a defensive asset, the sector is now evolving into a new role that combines stable cash flow with structural growth momentum.

Regarding bond allocation, Nomura analyses that today’s bond market is attractive not only because of expectations of a policy rate pivot but also because overall yields are at historically high relative levels, giving bonds strong return characteristics. In terms of tactics, investors need not bet solely on rate direction; they should manage duration, credit quality and yield sources—e.g., increase holdings of 5‑ to 10‑year bonds, focus on high‑quality corporate bonds from mature economies, and modestly add subordinated financial bonds—to capture high yields while enhancing portfolio stability.

Looking ahead, Nomura stresses that market volatility does not mean investors must exit; the key is to reduce portfolio concentration risk. AI remains the core mid‑to‑long‑term theme, and as AI development drives massive demand for power and energy facilities, opportunities flow from tech hardware to infrastructure. By pairing AI growth exposure with infrastructure assets that benefit from AI‑driven electricity demand and attractive‑yield bonds, a cross‑sector, cross‑asset diversified layout can build an all‑weather portfolio that balances growth, income and stability amid market swings.

items.title: 俄烏戰爭再升溫！澤倫斯基下令加強攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠、反制普丁冬季空襲
items.title_en: War Between Russia and Ukraine Heats Up Again! Zelensky Orders Stronger Attacks on Russian Refineries, Counters Putin's Winter Strikes
paras: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskiy）表示，為回應俄羅斯採取新的空襲策略，試圖迫使基輔及其他城市的居民撤離，烏克蘭將加大對俄羅斯煉油廠的攻擊力度，但不會將平民列為攻擊目標。
根據《路透》報導，澤倫斯基指出，烏克蘭情報單位已取得的相關文件顯示，俄羅斯總統普丁（Vladimir Putin）已在今年冬季來臨前發布一項新的軍事攻擊方針，將攻擊範圍擴大至更多民用目標。
澤倫斯基表示：「我們看過這些文件，也知道他們獲准攻擊基礎設施、物流系統、道路、學校及醫院，藉此向民眾施壓，迫使他們離開首都及其他城市。這就是這項行動的目的。」
澤倫斯基認為，普丁之所以改變軍事策略，是為了在軍隊於重要前線地區失去陣地、傷亡人數增加之際，維持強勢形象。
俄羅斯克里姆林宮週六（3日）未回應相關指控。不過，俄羅斯外交部在一份呼籲外國公民離開基輔的聲明中表示，俄方將持續、有系統地打擊目標，並稱這些行動是為了報復烏克蘭近幾個月對俄羅斯發動的攻擊。
俄烏雙方均否認蓄意以平民為攻擊目標。
澤倫斯基表示，烏克蘭目前正展開一項代號為「維瓦爾第」（Vivaldi）的反攻行動，已在烏克蘭東部頓巴斯（Donbas）地區收復約140平方公里土地。
俄羅斯則表示，全面控制頓巴斯是達成任何和平協議的必要條件。
近幾週，美國總統川普政府持續尋求重啟談判，試圖結束已延續4年的俄烏戰爭。這場衝突也是第二次世界大戰以來，歐洲死傷最慘重的戰爭。
川普上個月曾敦促烏克蘭停止攻擊俄羅斯石油設施，認為相關行動正推升全球柴油價格。
不過，澤倫斯基表示，俄羅斯並未釋出任何有意與烏克蘭展開和平談判的訊號，也沒有意願討論針對能源基礎設施的停火安排。
過去一週，俄羅斯持續以無人機及飛彈攻擊基輔，鎖定能源與電信設施，以及公路和鐵路等交通基礎設施。俄軍更首度將攻擊目標延伸至橫跨第聶伯河（Dnipro River）、連接基輔東西兩側的橋梁。
面對俄羅斯調整攻擊策略，澤倫斯基強調，烏克蘭必須採取反制措施，但不會仿效俄軍，無差別攻擊民用設施。
他以英文表示：「我們必須以任何可行的方式作出回應。他們攻擊我們的能源設施，我們就必須反擊他們的能源設施。首先是煉油廠，因為這些設施為他們的戰爭提供資金。」
澤倫斯基並強調：「但我們當然不會像他們一樣，攻擊任何民用目標。」
paras_en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said that in response to Russia's new aerial‑strike strategy aimed at forcing residents of Kyiv and other cities to evacuate, Ukraine will intensify attacks on Russian oil refineries, but will not target civilians.

According to Reuters, Zelensky noted that Ukrainian intelligence documents show Russian President Vladimir Putin has issued a new military‑attack directive before this winter, expanding the strike scope to include more civilian targets.

Zelensky said, "We have seen these documents and we know they have been authorized to hit infrastructure, logistics systems, roads, schools and hospitals, using them to pressure the public and force them out of the capital and other cities. That is the purpose of this operation."
Zelensky believes Putin changed his military strategy to maintain a strong image as his troops lose ground and casualties rise in key frontline areas.

The Kremlin did not respond to the allegations on Saturday (the 3rd). However, Russia’s foreign ministry, in a statement urging foreign citizens to leave Kyiv, said Moscow will continue to strike targets systematically and framed the actions as retaliation for Ukrainian attacks launched in recent months.
Both Russia and Ukraine deny deliberately targeting civilians.
Zelensky said Ukraine is currently conducting a counter‑offensive code‑named "Vivaldi," which has recaptured about 140 square kilometres in the Donbas region of eastern Ukraine.
Russia, on the other hand, says full control of Donbas is a prerequisite for any peace agreement.

In recent weeks, the Trump administration in the United States has been seeking to restart negotiations to end the four‑year‑long Russia‑Ukraine war, the deadliest conflict in Europe since World War II.
Last month, Trump urged Ukraine to stop striking Russian oil facilities, arguing that such actions were driving up global diesel prices.
Zelensky replied that Russia has shown no sign of wanting to negotiate peace with Ukraine and has no intention of discussing a cease‑fire on energy infrastructure.

Over the past week Russia has continued to use drones and missiles against Kyiv, targeting energy and telecommunications facilities as well as road and rail infrastructure, and for the first time extended attacks to the bridge spanning the Dnipro River that links Kyiv’s east and west sides.
Facing Russia’s shift in attack strategy, Zelensky stressed that Ukraine must take countermeasures but will not mimic the Russian army’s indiscriminate attacks on civilian facilities.

He said in English, "We must respond in any way we can. They attack our energy facilities, we have to strike back at their energy facilities. First are the refineries, because those facilities fund their war."
Zelensky added, "But of course we will not do as they do and attack any civilian targets."

items.title: 川普任命國家情報總監為「AI沙皇」！白宮成立超級智慧工作小組、120天內評估風險
items.title_en: Trump Appoints National Intelligence Director as 'AI Tsar'! White House Forms Super‑Intelligence Task Force, to Assess Risks Within 120 Days
paras: 美國總統川普任命國家情報總監克雷頓（Jay Clayton）領導白宮新成立的「超級智慧工作小組」（Super Intelligence Force），負責評估人工智慧（AI）帶來的風險與機會，並釐清聯邦政府應在AI治理中扮演的角色。工作小組須在120天內提交報告，這項任命也使克雷頓成為川普政府新任AI事務負責人。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，克雷頓已證實將領導「超級智慧工作小組」。他表示，川普要求成立專責團隊，確保美國持續在超級智慧領域保持領先，同時將美國人民的利益置於首位。
他也警告，若未能搶得領先地位，將面臨重大風險。
根據工作小組章程，團隊將檢視AI相關風險，以及政府現行針對資安漏洞、駭客攻擊及其他事件的通報機制，並在既有權限下，提出強化聯邦政府應對能力的建議。
這是川普第二度任命高階顧問統籌政府內部的AI政策。創投家薩克斯（David Sacks）曾在川普第二任期初期擔任AI事務負責人。
工作小組副主席包括麥可（Emil Michael）、庫珀（Scott Kupor）及美國聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）主席佛格森（Andrew Ferguson）。
成員則包括副總統范斯（JD Vance）、國防部長赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）、財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）及白宮幕僚長威爾斯（Susie Wiles）。外部顧問則包括薩克斯與美國前國務卿萊斯（Condoleezza Rice）。

川普拒絕加強AI監管 優先維持對中競爭優勢

隨著AI安全疑慮升高，部分研究人員警告，開發這項技術的人士認為，AI可能在未來10年內對人類造成致命威脅。美國民主、共和兩黨多名國會議員對此表達憂慮，並呼籲採取更多行動。
不過，川普對AI監管採取相對寬鬆的立場，反對新增監管措施，認為過度監督可能削弱美國與中國競爭的能力。他也表示，不希望與中國國家主席習近平合作制定AI技術治理規範。
相較於加強政府監管，川普更重視維持美國在AI領域的領先地位，並支持透過自願性框架管理相關風險，包括引入外部安全稽核及強化企業內部管控。
川普本週與產業高層會面時表示，美國目前擁有相當大的領先優勢，並將持續保持領先，認為這是非常正面的發展。
另一方面，貝森特對AI產業如何因應潛在風險提出不同角度的看法。他批評部分知名AI業界領袖對AI可能帶來生存威脅的警告過於危言聳聽，且無助於解決問題，並呼籲業者自行監管、提出解決方案。
貝森特在週六（3日）刊出的《Axios》專訪中表示，AI實驗室必須承擔自身責任，並認為業界已逐漸接受這項理念。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump has appointed National Intelligence Director Jay Clayton to lead the White House’s newly created “Super Intelligence Task Force,” which will evaluate the risks and opportunities posed by artificial intelligence (AI) and clarify the role the federal government should play in AI governance. The task force must submit a report within 120 days, making Clayton the Trump administration’s new point person on AI matters.

According to the Wall Street Journal, Clayton has confirmed he will head the Super Intelligence Task Force. He said Trump demanded a dedicated team to ensure the United States remains a leader in super‑intelligence while putting the interests of the American people first.
He also warned that failing to secure a leading position could expose the country to significant risks.

Under the task force’s charter, the team will examine AI‑related risks and review the government’s existing reporting mechanisms for cybersecurity vulnerabilities, hacker attacks, and other incidents, and, within its authority, propose recommendations to strengthen the federal government’s response capabilities.
This is the second time Trump has appointed a senior adviser to coordinate internal AI policy. Venture capitalist David Sacks served as the AI point person early in Trump’s second term.
The task force’s vice‑chairmen include Emil Michael, Scott Kupor, and FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson.

Members include Vice President JD Vance, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, and White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles. External advisers include David Sacks and former Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice.

Trump refuses to tighten AI regulation, prioritizing the maintenance of a competitive edge over China. As AI safety concerns rise, some researchers warn that developers could create technology that poses an existential threat to humanity within the next decade. Several Democratic and Republican lawmakers have expressed alarm and called for more action.

However, Trump takes a relatively lax stance on AI oversight, opposing new regulatory measures and arguing that excessive supervision could weaken the United States’ ability to compete with China. He also said he does not want to cooperate with Chinese President Xi Jinping on AI governance standards.

Rather than expanding government regulation, Trump places greater emphasis on preserving U.S. leadership in AI and supports managing related risks through voluntary frameworks, including external security audits and stronger internal corporate controls.

During meetings with industry leaders this week, Trump said the United States currently enjoys a substantial lead in AI and will continue to maintain that advantage, describing the situation as a very positive development.

On the other hand, Bessent offered a different perspective on how the AI industry should address potential risks. He criticized some prominent AI executives for sounding overly alarmist about existential threats, saying such warnings do little to solve problems, and urged companies to self‑regulate and propose solutions.
In an Axios interview published on Saturday (the 3rd), Bessent said AI labs must take responsibility for themselves and noted that the industry is gradually embracing this notion.

items.title: 台股無懼國際市場紛擾逆風創高 下周關注這些「變數」
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks Defy International Turbulence, Reach New Highs; Watch These Variables Next Week
paras: 本周全球金融市場在經濟數據與地緣政治交錯下展現韌性，受惠美國個人消費支出物價指數降溫與人工智慧投資熱潮，美股科技巨擘領軍強勢走高。科技多頭氣勢同步帶動台灣股市，在台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 與電子類股領軍下，台股勢如破竹寫下歷史新高。展望下周，投資人應密切關注中東戰事演變、聯準會會議紀錄、川普關稅政策及重要企業財報，這些變數將主導股債與原物料下一步走向，建議投資人維持多元資產配置以應對市場波動。
觀察本周台股與美股周一至周五的具體漲跌幅數據，美國三大指數受通膨與升息疑慮拖累全面走跌，道瓊工業指數一周下跌1.74%，史坦普500指數一周下跌0.98%，那斯達克指數跌幅相對較輕，一周下跌0.72%。反觀台灣股市表現獨強，台灣加權股價指數本周逆勢上漲0.94%，成為少數在國際逆風中維持強勢上揚的市場

items.title: 鴻海攜手輝達推進機器人組裝技術導入GB300生產 Busbar組裝成功率超過95%
items.title_en: Foxconn Teams with NVIDIA to Advance Robot Assembly Technology, GB300 Busbar Assembly Success Rate Exceeds 95%
paras: 輝達(NVIDIA)(NVDA-US)技術部最新文章指出，技術團隊攜手鴻海(2317-TW)將最新機器人自動化技術導入GB300組裝製程，目前Busbar(匯流排)組裝成功率已超過95%，多連接器插接成功率約90%至95%，並持續朝製造端要求的99.5%成功率邁進。
此次合作由輝達西雅圖機器人實驗室(Seattle Robotics Lab, SRL)與Isaac工程團隊共同推進，並與輝達營運團隊及代工夥伴鴻海合作，針對GB300測試托盤(tester trays)組裝中的Busbar組裝及多連接器插接兩項任務進行機器人訓練與測試。輝達指出，這兩項任務也是由營運團隊與鴻海共同建議鎖定的關鍵應用。
技術團隊指出，由於GB300測試托盤的零件擺放、幾何形狀及纜線狀態存在不確定性，無法完全依賴傳統固定式自動化，因此採取傳統機器人感知、規劃與控制技術，搭配機器人學習等方法，依不同任務尋找適合的解決方案，並以實際製造需求作為成功率與作業時間的評估標準。
其中，Busbar組裝涉及將長且沉重的Busbar插入托盤、鎖固16顆螺絲，以及相關治具與夾具的安裝、拆卸，目前成功率已超過95%。不過，受到螺絲需逐一鎖固影響，目前整體作業時間約160秒，團隊表示，後續將持續優化，朝縮短至124秒內的目標邁進。
多連接器插接則涉及2個大型及2個小型電氣連接器，機器人需提起帶有可變形纜線的連接器，再精準插入間隙極小的對應插座，目前成功率約90%至95%，4組連接器的作業時間目標控制在72秒內，整體作業週期時間(cycle time)則以不超過熟練人工2倍時間為目標。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) technical department’s latest article notes that its team, together with Foxconn (2317-TW), has introduced the newest robotic automation technology into the GB300 assembly process, achieving a busbar assembly success rate of over 95% and a multi‑connector insertion success rate of roughly 90%‑95%, while continuing to push toward the manufacturing‑side target of 99.5% success.

The collaboration is driven by NVIDIA’s Seattle Robotics Lab (SRL) and the Isaac engineering team, working alongside NVIDIA’s operations group and contract‑manufacturing partner Foxconn. They are training and testing robots on two tasks in the GB300 tester‑tray assembly – busbar installation and multi‑connector insertion – which the operations team and Foxconn identified as key applications.

The technical team explains that because the placement, geometry, and cable condition of GB300 tester‑tray components are uncertain, traditional fixed‑line automation cannot be relied upon. Instead, they employ conventional robot perception, planning and control techniques combined with robot learning methods, selecting solutions tailored to each task and using actual manufacturing requirements as the benchmark for success rates and cycle times.

Busbar assembly involves inserting a long, heavy busbar into the tray, securing it with 16 screws, and installing or removing related fixtures and clamps. The current success rate has surpassed 95%. However, because each screw must be tightened individually, the overall operation takes about 160 seconds; the team aims to further optimize the process to bring the time down to under 124 seconds.

Multi‑connector insertion deals with two large and two small electrical connectors. The robot must lift a connector with a deformable cable and precisely insert it into a very tight socket. Success is currently around 90%‑95%, with a target of completing the four‑connector operation within 72 seconds, and the overall cycle time is aimed to be no more than twice that of a skilled human operator.

items.title: 精測9月、Q3營收雙創新高 前三季已超越去年全年
items.title_en: Advantest Posts Record September and Q3 Revenue, Beats Full-Year 2025 Levels in First Three Quarters
paras: 測試介面廠精測(6510-TW)公布9月營收新台幣6.52億元，月成長2.1%，年增55.9%，第三季營收19.05億元，季成長16.2%，年增53.4%，累計前三季營收達49.02億元，年增35.8%，已超越2025年全年營收水準。精測指出，受惠AI相關應用晶片測試介面需求持續放量，產能利用率維持高檔，帶動單月與累計營收同步創歷史新高。
精測9月營收主要受惠AI、高效能運算(HPC)與專用積體電路(AI ASIC)客戶訂單同步增長，成為推升整體營收成長的核心引擎。隨著AI晶片與資料中心基礎建設持續擴張，半導體產業正從單純的製程微縮，加速邁向以異質整合與先進封裝為核心的技術，測試已不再只是製造末端的品質確認，而成為影響良率、可靠度與量產效率的關鍵環節，同步推升測試介面的技術門檻與需求強度。
精測於「2026 SEMICON Taiwan國際半導體展」展出次世代高頻、高功率與高腳數探針卡，以及IC測試載板、高功率老化測試板等測試介面解決方案，聚焦大電流供應、低阻抗電源路徑、訊號完整性(SI)與散熱控制等關鍵能力，展期與國際大廠進行深度技術交流，有效拓展合作機會並帶動後續訂單與驗證案件，可望為第四季及2027年業務動能奠定基礎。
展望後市，隨著各大雲端服務業者(CSP)持續加碼建置AI資料中心，加上客戶新一代AI晶片陸續進入工程驗證階段，整體需求能見度保持正向，顯示AI相關成長動能並非短期效應，而是具備中長期成長動能的產業趨勢。
精測為因應客戶未來發展規劃，正持續擴充產能，在既有產線滿載運作下，已同步展開廠房空間規劃與導入自動化設備，以縮短從設計、模擬、驗證到量產導入的週期、滿足客戶對交付時程的要求。
paras_en: Advantest (6510-TW) reported September revenue of NT$652 million, up 2.1% month‑over‑month and 55.9% year‑over‑year. The third quarter revenue reached NT$1.905 billion, a 16.2% quarterly increase and 53.4% annual rise, bringing cumulative revenue for the first three quarters to NT$4.902 billion, up 35.8% year‑over‑year and already surpassing the full‑year 2025 revenue level. Advantest said the continued surge in demand for AI‑related chip test interfaces kept capacity utilization high, driving both monthly and cumulative revenues to historic highs.

The September revenue boost came mainly from simultaneous order growth from AI, high‑performance computing (HPC) and AI ASIC customers, which acted as the core engine of overall revenue growth. As AI chips and data‑center infrastructure keep expanding, the semiconductor industry is shifting from pure process scaling to heterogenous integration and advanced packaging. Testing is no longer just an end‑of‑line quality check but a critical step that influences yield, reliability and production efficiency, thereby raising the technical bar and demand intensity for test interfaces.

At the 2026 SEMICON Taiwan International Semiconductor Exhibition, Advantest showcased next‑generation high‑frequency, high‑power, high‑pin‑count probe cards, as well as IC test substrates, high‑power aging test boards and other test‑interface solutions. The focus was on capabilities such as large‑current supply, low‑impedance power paths, signal integrity and thermal management. During the show, deep technical exchanges with major international players were held, expanding cooperation opportunities and driving follow‑on orders and validation projects, which are expected to lay the foundation for Q4 and 2027 business momentum.

Looking ahead, major cloud service providers continue to invest heavily in AI data centers, and customers’ next‑generation AI chips are entering engineering validation stages. Overall demand visibility remains positive, indicating that AI‑related growth is not a short‑term effect but a medium‑to‑long‑term industry trend.

To meet customers’ future development plans, Advantest is expanding capacity. While existing production lines are running at full load, the company has begun plant‑space planning and the introduction of automation equipment to shorten the cycle from design, simulation and validation to mass‑production introduction, satisfying customers’ delivery‑time requirements.

items.title: 成本壓力難擋家電業迎漲價 業者瞄準2027年新能效標準搶攻換機商機
items.title_en: Cost Pressures Spur Price Hikes in Home Appliance Industry; Players Target 2027 New Energy‑Efficiency Standards to Capture Replacement Market
paras: 台灣家電產業近期面臨銅、塑膠粒等原物料以及物流運費齊揚的沉重成本壓力，家電品牌廠與通路商紛紛啟動價格調整機制，包括聲寶(1604-TW)與燦坤(2430-TW)皆提出將會有漲價潮，且在加上經濟部修訂2027年即將上路的新版能源效率制度大幅拉高門檻，整體市場正迎來一波因應漲價與政策換軌的提前汰舊換新商機。
針對產品價格調幅與成本結構，聲寶說明雖然民生買氣偏向保守，但源頭原物料上漲已使業者難以承受，市場普遍預期一般冰箱與洗衣機產品漲幅落在3%至5%左右，其中受記憶體價格大漲影響，液晶電視成為成本反映最為明顯的主力品項。
通路龍頭燦坤也在今年稍早指出，空調與冰箱本體價格約上漲1000至3000元，空調安裝因銅管等原料走揚導致超出標準安裝費用增加20%至30%，中東戰事亦帶動塑膠原料緊繃，使風扇等小家電也面臨量縮價揚的壓力。
面對生產端成本上升與供給端價格調漲，各大家電業者積極轉向節能政策紅利尋求突破口。由於經濟部修訂冰箱能源效率分級標準與檢驗要求，2027年起能效門檻將大幅提高，促使通路與品牌提前啟動布局。
燦坤率先攜手國際一線品牌祭出一級能效冰箱與洗衣機8折起優惠，並搭配政府最高5000元的節能補助與貨物稅減徵，期望在政策過渡期擴大市占率並催化新一波汰換買氣。
品牌廠亦全力將核心產品線朝高能效與高毛利規格推動。三洋電(1614-TW)指出，隨著全台用電量攀升與能源基準調升，全系列空調與冰箱已全面符合一級能效，積極瞄準未來的節能換機潮。
禾聯碩(5283-TW)則在完成董事改選後確立未來三年落實本業轉型，聚焦開發高附加價值與高毛利產品，空調設備年銷維持20多萬台，並透過副品牌山田家電擴大市場滲透率。
在大環境面臨通膨、原物料成本墊高與消費保守等多重拉鋸下，台灣家電市場逐步走向高規格節能剛性需求的競爭格局。業者透過加速清理舊規庫存、切入2027新能效一級標準機型，並搭配資產活化與多元通路布局，力求在漲價潮與政策轉型期中穩固獲利韌性。
paras_en: Taiwan's home‑appliance sector is currently grappling with steep cost pressures as raw‑material prices—such as copper and plastic pellets—and logistics freight have all surged. Major brands and retailers are activating price‑adjustment mechanisms; both Sampo (1604‑TW) and Tsann‑Kuen (2430‑TW) have warned of an upcoming wave of price hikes. In addition, the Ministry of Economic Affairs is revising the energy‑efficiency regime slated for 2027, raising the standards dramatically, which together create an early‑stage replacement opportunity driven by both price increases and policy shifts.

Sampo explained that although consumer demand remains cautious, the rise in upstream raw‑material costs has become unbearable for the industry. The market generally expects price increases of about 3%‑5% for typical refrigerators and washing machines, while LCD TVs—hit hard by soaring memory‑chip prices—show the most pronounced cost pass‑through.

Tsann‑Kuen, a leading retailer, noted earlier this year that the base prices of air‑conditioners and refrigerators have risen by roughly NT$1,000‑3,000. Installation costs for air‑conditioners have jumped 20%‑30% because of higher copper‑tube prices, and the Middle‑East conflict has tightened plastic‑material supplies, putting pressure on small appliances such as fans to face both volume cuts and price hikes.

Facing higher production costs and upstream price adjustments, major appliance makers are actively seeking breakthroughs through energy‑efficiency incentives. The Ministry of Economic Affairs’ revision of refrigerator energy‑efficiency grading and testing requirements will raise the efficiency threshold substantially from 2027, prompting brands and retailers to pre‑emptively position themselves.

Tsann‑Kuen is first to partner with top international brands to offer up to 20% off on Class‑1‑efficiency refrigerators and washing machines, combined with the government’s maximum NT$5,000 energy‑saving subsidy and reduced commodity taxes, aiming to expand market share and spark a new wave of replacement purchases during the policy transition period.

Brand manufacturers are also pushing core product lines toward higher efficiency and higher‑margin specifications. Sanyo Electric (1614‑TW) said that, as nationwide electricity consumption climbs and energy benchmarks rise, its entire range of air‑conditioners and refrigerators now meets Class‑1 efficiency, positioning the company to capture the forthcoming energy‑saving replacement wave.

He Lian Shuo (5283‑TW) confirmed, after a board‑member election, a three‑year plan to transform its core business toward high‑value‑added, high‑margin products. It will maintain annual sales of over 200,000 air‑conditioning units and expand market penetration through its sub‑brand Yamada Home Appliances.

Amid broader inflation, rising raw‑material costs and cautious consumer sentiment, Taiwan’s home‑appliance market is gradually shifting toward a competitive landscape defined by high‑spec, energy‑efficient demand. Companies are accelerating the clearance of old‑stock, targeting 2027 Class‑1 models, and leveraging asset revitalization and diversified channel strategies to preserve profit resilience during the price‑rise and policy‑transition phases.

paras_en: The Taiwan Weighted Index closed at 48,475.74 points on October 2, setting another historic high, with the total market value of listed stocks reaching NT$170.17 trillion. Amid this wave of capital inflows, 18 ETFs posted record‑high prices, eight of which are active‑managed funds, covering themes such as Taiwan equities, global technology, cybersecurity and sustainable ESG, indicating that the bull market is spreading across various thematic investments.

Active ETFs have sparked a fundraising boom this year. Among the 18 ETFs that reached new highs, active funds account for eight, about 44%, showing that managers’ flexible stock‑picking and dynamic adjustment strategies can deliver strong excess returns in a rallying market.

Looking closer, six of the active ETFs are Taiwan‑focused: Cathay Active Momentum High‑Yield (00400A‑TW), Morgan Stanley Taiwan Xin‑Shou (00401A‑TW), KGI Taiwan (00407A‑TW), Nomura Taiwan Select (00980A‑TW), Nomura Taiwan 50 (00985A‑TW) and SinoPac Technology Trend (00410A‑TW). High‑profile funds such as Fubon MoTai (0057‑TW) and SinoPac Taiwan Weighted (006204‑TW) have shown very strong price momentum. Popular domestic cap‑weighted ETFs like Fubon Taiwan 50 (006208‑TW) and Yuanta MSCI Taiwan (006203‑TW) also climbed to fresh peaks.

Beyond Taiwan‑focused ETFs, overseas technology and niche‑sector ETFs also benefited from the global tech wave and industry recovery. Yuanta Global AI (00762‑TW) and Cathay Cybersecurity (00875‑TW) each continued to post strong performance.

CITIC Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB (009828‑TW) was listed in early September and immediately faced a series of “ghost story” setbacks in the PCB and CCL sectors. The fund fell below its NT$10 issue price, hitting a low of NT$9.16, but as capital re‑accumulated it rebounded sharply, closing at NT$10.68 on October 2 and setting a new post‑listing high.

Institutional investors note that the Taiwan market’s total valuation breaking NT$170 trillion not only reflects a strong fundamentals backdrop but also signals high confidence in future industry growth. When positioning for a record‑high market, they recommend two main approaches: a core allocation using cap‑weighted or high‑weight thematic ETFs for steady participation in market growth, and a satellite allocation with active or trend‑themed ETFs to seek excess returns.

items.title: 傳台積電可能參加Terafab晶圓項目　馬斯克：僅處於討論階段 但可能有所進展
items.title_en: TSMC May Join Terafab Wafer Project; Musk Says It’s Only at the Discussion Stage but Could Progress
paras: 市場周六(3日)傳出台積電正評估與馬斯克旗下SpaceX、特斯拉共同發起的Terafab晶圓計畫合作，馬斯克則在X平台上回應稱相關接觸「僅處於討論階段」，但「可能會有所進展」，未承諾任何協議。
Terafab今年3月由馬斯克公布，規劃設於德州奧斯汀附近，由特斯拉、SpaceX推動，目標年產約1TW算力，供AI、自動駕駛、機器人與太空資料中心使用。
外界預估，初期投資金額為200億至250億美元，另有說法第一階段逾168億美元。該案早前已牽線英特爾，如今納入台積電，凸顯先進廠從零自建的技術、人才與良率門檻。
知情人士透露，雙方合作可能採兩套架構：一是由台積電持有並營運德州新廠，Terafab以股權加長期採購保證產能；二由Terafab握多數股，台積電出技術、營運與少量資金。
paras_en: The market reported on Saturday (the 3rd) that TSMC is evaluating a partnership on the Terafab wafer project launched jointly by Elon Musk’s SpaceX and Tesla. Musk responded on the X platform that the talks are “only at the discussion stage,” but “could see progress,” without committing to any agreement.

Terafab was announced by Musk in March of this year, with plans to locate near Austin, Texas, driven by Tesla and SpaceX. The project aims for an annual output of roughly 1 TW of compute power to serve AI, autonomous driving, robotics, and space data‑center applications.

Analysts estimate the initial investment at $20 billion to $25 billion, with some reports putting the first phase at over $16.8 billion. The deal, which previously involved Intel, now includes TSMC, highlighting the high technical, talent and yield barriers of building an advanced fab from scratch.

Sources familiar with the matter say the collaboration could take one of two structures: either TSMC would own and operate a new plant in Texas, with Terafab providing equity and long‑term purchase guarantees for capacity; or Terafab would hold a majority stake while TSMC supplies technology, operational expertise, and a modest amount of capital.

items.title: 〈房產〉聯上發：新店「聯上澐朗」火警已撲滅 無人員傷亡
items.title_en: Real Estate: Lian Shang Fa Reports Xindian “Lian Shang Yunlang” Fire Extinguished with No Injuries
paras: 上市建商聯上發(2537-TW)在新北市興建中的新店「聯上澐朗」個案工地，今(3)日凌晨傳出火警，聯上發在今天中午指出，警消單位獲報立即前往進行撲滅火勢，現場並無人員傷亡，詳細失火原因待火調相關單位調查。
聯上發興建中新店「聯上澐朗」個案工地位於新店區十四張路與斯馨路口，預計興建33層SRC鋼骨住宅大樓，市場估計總銷售金額超過100億元，爲區域指標個案，今日凌晨傳出火警也引發市場關注。
聯上發指出，新店「聯上澐朗」個案地已依規定投保相關保險，初步評估對本公司整體營運及財務尚無重大影響。本公司將委託專業鑑定單位進行結構安全鑑定，以確保此一個案建築物結構安全。
paras_en: Listed developer Lian Shang Fa (2537‑TW) reported that a fire broke out in the early hours of the 3rd at its Xindian “Lian Shang Yunlang” construction site. The company said fire and rescue units were dispatched immediately upon notification, the blaze was extinguished, and no one was injured. The cause of the fire is pending investigation by the relevant authorities.

The Xindian “Lian Shang Yunlang” site is located at the intersection of Shisi‑Zhang Road and Si‑Xin Road in Xindian District. The project plans a 33‑storey SRC steel‑frame residential tower, with market estimates of total sales exceeding NT$10 billion, making it a flagship development in the area. The early‑morning fire has drawn market attention.

Lian Shang Fa stated that the project is fully insured as required and a preliminary assessment indicates no material impact on the company’s overall operations or financial condition. The firm will engage a professional appraisal agency to conduct a structural safety assessment to ensure the building’s structural integrity.

items.title: 蘋果證實iPhone 18 Pro Max爆斷訊問題！受影響用戶須更換手機
items.title_en: Apple Confirms iPhone 18 Pro Max Connectivity Issue; Affected Users Must Replace Device
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 證實，「少數」使用美國電信商AT&T(T-US) 網路的iPhone 18 Pro Max出現行動網路連線問題，導致裝置無法使用電信服務，甚至無法撥打電話。
根據《9to5Mac》報導，蘋果已推出軟體更新及電信業者設定更新，以防止問題影響更多用戶。不過，蘋果表示，已經失去行動網路服務的裝置必須更換硬體才能恢復正常使用。
蘋果向科技媒體《9to5Mac》表示，公司已確認少數使用AT&T網路的iPhone 18 Pro Max受到影響，可能出現裝置失去行動網路服務、無法撥打電話等情況。
為防止更多用戶遇到相同問題，蘋果已於本週稍早推出iOS 27.0.1，並呼籲所有iPhone 18 Pro Max用戶立即更新。此外，蘋果也將於當天發布電信業者設定更新，兩項更新將共同降低問題發生的風險。
這項電信業者設定更新將在未來14天內自動下載至iPhone 18 Pro Max。用戶若希望立即安裝，也可以自行前往「設定」，依序點選「一般」及「關於本機」，手動更新。
不過，蘋果強調，這些更新僅能預防問題再次發生，無法修復已經失去行動網路服務的裝置。
蘋果表示，已經發生斷訊的iPhone 18 Pro Max用戶需要更換新手機。這些用戶應聯繫蘋果支援或AT&T，或前往Apple Store及AT&T門市尋求協助。
根據《9to5Mac》稍早報導，受影響的iPhone 18 Pro Max無法連接AT&T網路，因此無法使用通話、簡訊及行動數據服務，手機狀態列則會顯示「SOS」，代表裝置無法正常連接電信網路。
不過，這項問題並未影響所有使用AT&T網路的iPhone 18 Pro Max用戶。
值得注意的是，美國市場販售的iPhone 18 Pro Max搭載高通(QCOM-US) 數據機晶片，而採用蘋果自研C2數據機晶片的iPhone 18 Pro則未受到這次AT&T連線問題影響。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) has confirmed that a "small number" of iPhone 18 Pro Max units using AT&T (T-US) network in the United States are experiencing mobile network connectivity problems, preventing the devices from using cellular services and even making calls.

According to a report by 9to5Mac, Apple has released a software update and a carrier settings update to prevent the issue from affecting more users. However, Apple says devices that have already lost mobile network service must have their hardware replaced to function normally again.
Apple told tech outlet 9to5Mac that the company has identified a small subset of iPhone 18 Pro Max units on AT&T’s network that may lose mobile service and be unable to place calls.

To stop more users from encountering the same problem, Apple rolled out iOS 27.0.1 earlier this week and urged all iPhone 18 Pro Max owners to update immediately. Apple will also release a carrier settings update the same day, with both updates working together to lower the risk of recurrence.

The carrier settings update will automatically download to iPhone 18 Pro Max devices within the next 14 days. Users who want to install it right away can go to Settings → General → About and trigger a manual update.
Apple emphasizes that these updates can only prevent the issue from happening again; they cannot fix devices that have already lost mobile network service.

Apple states that iPhone 18 Pro Max users who have already experienced a loss of service need to replace their phones. Those users should contact Apple Support or AT&T, or visit an Apple Store or AT&T retail location for assistance.

Earlier reporting by 9to5Mac noted that affected iPhone 18 Pro Max units cannot connect to AT&T’s network, rendering calls, texts and mobile data unusable, and the status bar shows "SOS," indicating the device cannot connect to a cellular network properly.
However, the problem does not affect all iPhone 18 Pro Max users on AT&T’s network.

It is worth noting that iPhone 18 Pro Max models sold in the U.S. are equipped with Qualcomm (QCOM-US) modem chips, while the iPhone 18 Pro, which uses Apple’s in‑house C2 modem, is not impacted by this AT&T connectivity issue.

items.title: 美國擬貸Vistra 42億美元，至少3座核電站擴大發電
items.title_en: U.S. Plans to Loan Vistra $4.2 Billion, Expand Generation at At Least Three Nuclear Plants
paras: 2026年10月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心帶動美國電力需求快速增加，美國政府準備透過融資支持既有核電站提高發電能力。根據外媒報導，美國政府將向Vistra(VST-US)提供約42億美元貸款，用於旗下至少3座核電站增容，美國能源部長Chris Wright預計10月5日正式宣布。
Vistra目前在美國營運4座核電站、共6座反應爐，總發電能力超過6.5GW。這次資金主要不是興建新的核電站，而是透過既有機組功率提升（uprate）增加供電，包括調整核燃料配置，以及更換主汽輪機等大型設備。
相較從零興建新核電站，既有機組增容可以直接利用原有電廠、輸電與相關基礎設施。路透指出，相關增容至少涵蓋Vistra旗下4座核電站中的3座，實際增加多少MW目前尚未揭露。
美國電力需求在多年停滯後重新成長，AI資料中心擴張是主要需求來源之一。Vistra這筆42億美元融資，也代表新增電力供給開始從長期核電規畫，進一步進入既有核電資產融資與設備改造階段。

paras_en: October 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – AI data centers are driving a rapid increase in U.S. electricity demand, and the U.S. government is preparing to finance upgrades that boost output at existing nuclear plants. According to foreign media, the U.S. government will provide Vistra (VST‑US) with a loan of about $4.2 billion to increase capacity at at least three of its nuclear stations, with Energy Secretary Chris Wright expected to announce it formally on October 5.

Vistra currently operates four nuclear plants in the United States, comprising six reactors with a total generating capacity of over 6.5 GW. The funding is not for building new reactors but for uprating existing units—raising power output by adjusting fuel configurations and replacing major equipment such as the main steam turbine.

Compared with building new reactors from scratch, uprating existing units can directly leverage the existing plant, transmission lines, and related infrastructure. Reuters noted that the uprate will cover at least three of Vistra’s four nuclear plants, though the exact megawatt increase has not been disclosed.

U.S. electricity demand, after years of stagnation, is growing again, with AI data‑center expansion being a key driver. Vistra’s $4.2 billion financing also signals that new power supply is moving from long‑term nuclear planning to the financing and equipment‑upgrade phase for existing nuclear assets.
